DIAGNOSIS READY: Lung Abscess

The clinical picture of a young male with a week-long history of productive cough, purulent sputum, and chest pain following influenza, combined with a non-compliant treatment history, strongly suggests a post-infectious lung abscess rather than cellulitis. I am requesting the Chest X-Ray to confirm the presence of a cavity or consolidation.
